'''No-Holds-Barred''' was an underground organization aligned to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="WHSV" /> It was a collective of [[Director/Legends|directors]] and [[Actor/Legends|actors]] that had been blacklisted by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and early funding was almost entirely provided by freedom-fighter and former [[Jedi Initiate/Legends]] [[Drun Cairnwick/Legends|Drun Cairnwick]].<ref name="GG6-1" /> They distributed [[Holovid/Legends|holovids]] that the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] had banned, especially holos about both the Rebellion and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. [[Corinna A'Daasha]] met the group at her club, the [[Glow Dome]] on [[Adarlon/Legends|Adarlon]] and became a rebel sympathizer due to both the group and the holovid content. She allowed the group to continue distributing the vids through her nightclub. The Empire was aware of their existence and had sent the [[Ipharian-Da'Lor]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], [[Vallikor En-Vahdi]], to find their members. He had tracked them down to the Glow Dome but had not gotten farther then that.<ref name="WHSV" />

When Drun Cairnwick was imprisoned on [[Gesaril]], they founded [[Cairn's Flying Circus]] as a way to search for him without attracting Imperial attention.

==Behind the scenes==
'No-Holds-Barred' was created for ''[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters]]''.
